texts: Hold, do not spend: how $THREE gates the expensive lanes
$25 held turns on 200k-poly generation and game-ready export. Draft and standard generation stay free either way. The write-up covers why the gate is a 402 you can watch work: three.ws/three

issues.quote: $25 held turns on 200k-poly generation and game-ready export
issues.problem: To a reader new to three.ws, 'generation' without a noun is ambiguous; the page frames it as high-quality 3D generation. The post is still understandable from the link and image, but '3D generation' would land instantly.
issues.fix: Change to "$25 held in $THREE turns on 200k-poly 3D generation and game-ready export" if a revision is ever made; not required, stays within the verified page wording.

posts: $25 held turns on 200k-poly generation and game-ready export. Draft and standard generation stay free either way. The write-up covers why the gate is a 402 you can watch work: three.ws/three
altText: A three.ws card reading 'Hold, don't spend.' beside a browser window showing the $THREE hold-to-access ladder, with the Bronze rung at $25 listing high-quality 200k poly generation and game-ready Unity and Unreal export, each badged LIVE

editor.summary: Every claim in the post matches a passed verification against the live page, the API probe confirms the 402 behavior, and the cover image shows exactly the Bronze rung the copy describes with no contradictions. Voice, length, and link rules are all satisfied; the only nit is that 'generation' could read more clearly as '3D generation' to a cold reader. Ship it.
